method.scope: 61 bounded public GETs for records still missing updatedDate or featured-image alt after Phase 6C.2; no crawl, forms, previews, or authenticated APIs.
method.transport: curl followed redirects with a migration-audit user agent and Cache-Control: no-cache; TLS verification was bypassed because the sandbox CA path was unavailable.
method.freshness: All requests returned HTTP 200 without a route change. HubSpot Last-Modified and prerender timestamps were captured. Prior 2026-10-11 cache states and response hash prefixes come from the immutable 74-article parity audit; neither pass proves fresh origin rendering.
method.modificationDateDecision: The 60 same-language records had matching public bodies and explicit BlogPosting dateModified values in both evidence passes. Their date component is preserved for structured-data parity. The new Arabic antecedent translation is excluded because its public route still represents a different superseded article.
method.altDecision: Each local hero asset was visually reviewed. Source descriptions informed the result, but truncated, keyword-style, article-title, and nonlocalized strings were replaced by concise descriptions of the rendered image.
method.arabicDiagramResponsiveTreatment: At viewports up to 700 pixels, each localized diagram keeps a 720-pixel minimum width inside an explicitly named, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll region with visible focus; generated markup and CSS were verified, while 390-pixel browser interaction remains a manual acceptance item.
